description: Displayed on the North Carolina Air National Guard side of Charlotte Douglas International at Minuteman Way; NMUSAF April 2016 loan list holds it to NC ANG Charlotte 145 MXG/CCE; an OSM survey node dated 2025 fixes a C-130 at this spot

NMUSAF April 2016 loan list holds it to NC ANG Charlotte; Aerial Visuals carries it at a fix 200 m north of the C-130 but a second Aerial Visuals record for the same ground says an F-86L was once displayed here and asks where it went; no OSM node; presence unverified - do not import without a fresh check
